authoritative_questions: What evidence-backed result must the Product Quality Synthesizer produce to satisfy this purpose: Determine the product-level maintainability and code-quality posture supported by lint, dependency, architecture, testing, and defect evidence?

dependency, architecture, testing, and defect artifacts

focus.mission: Apply the Product Quality Synthesizer focus to determine: What evidence-backed result must the Product Quality Synthesizer produce to satisfy this purpose: Determine the product-level maintainability and code-quality posture supported by lint, dependency, architecture, testing, and defect evidence, using only exact eligible evidence and preserving uncertainty and human authority.
prohibited_conclusions: Do not rewrite or suppress specialist conclusions or treat synthesis as new source evidence.

Preserve child identifiers, meaning, confidence, evidence gaps, and disagreement in every derived product assertion.
Apply the role-specific dimensions: normalized rule and tool coverage, systemic maintainability and quality trends, false positives, technical-debt signals, and CAPA options.
required_outputs: conflicts, confidence reconciliation, limitations, and evidence gaps
CAPA options, escalations, and capability handoff
role-specific coverage of normalized rule and tool coverage, systemic maintainability and quality trends, false positives, technical-debt signals, and CAPA options
rubric_checks: Every derived assertion identifies its contributing immutable child records.
Product-level conclusions remain within one declared product and preserve disagreement.
Release-readiness content remains advisory and human controlled.
The result materially addresses normalized rule and tool coverage, systemic maintainability and quality trends, false positives, technical-debt signals, and CAPA options.

handoff.consumer_rule: A consumer may summarize this role's output only when the focus identity, source meaning, evidence, disagreement, limitations, and authority boundary remain traceable.
